info.title: RAgents JSON-RPC API
info.description: This profile requires no sign-in. Profiles with users use session cookies; without users, ACCESS_TOKEN can protect the existing access.

actorHandle.description: Address of the actor without @: room.handle in a room, the handle in the main room

methods.name: ragents.actor-programs.invocation
methods.description: Read the state of a call of an actor view.

appId.description: Identifier of the actor view or the program

methods.name: ragents.ask.answer
methods.description: Answer or dismiss the questions of one ask_user call. Rights: runs.read and runs.write.

selected.description: Labels of the chosen options; exactly one unless the question has multiSelect

text.description: A free answer instead of an option

items.description: The answer to one question: the chosen options or a free answer

answers.description: One answer per question, in the order of the questions; required unless dismiss is true

dismiss.description: true dismisses all questions of the call without answers; not together with answers

methods.name: ragents.chat.actorHistory
methods.description: The conversation histories of all actors of the run, without runs.inspect without tool details. Right: runs.read.

methods.name: ragents.chat.capabilities
methods.description: Which attachments an actor's model accepts; the model name appears only with runs.inspect. Right: runs.read.

methods.name: ragents.chat.send
methods.description: A message to the run's coordinator; starts a new run or cuts into a running one. With entry, it starts the run through this skill template and the start options it fixes. Rights: runs.read and runs.write, for a new run runs.create; for the global chat its rights.

entry.description: Id of the skill template through which this message starts the run

methods.name: ragents.chat.sendToActor
methods.description: A message to a specific LLM actor of the run. Rights as for ragents.chat.send.

methods.name: ragents.chat.start
methods.description: Start a run through a script template, without a message; the start options the template fixes apply. Returns once the start is accepted; progress and errors appear in the chat. In a running run it starts an embeddable script like ragents.runs.startScript. Rights: runs.read, runs.write and the template's release.

methods.name: ragents.chat.stop
methods.description: Emergency stop for the whole run: aborts all turns and a running start and stops all actors. ragents.runs.interruptTurn interrupts a single turn. Rights: runs.read and runs.write.

methods.name: ragents.documents.files
methods.description: A run's file store as groups and loose files. Right: runs.read.

methods.name: ragents.external.set
methods.description: Turn external access on or off; only from the local machine. Right: settings.write.

methods.name: ragents.lsp-fsharp.snapshot
methods.description: State and diagnostics of the language server ragents.lsp-fsharp in a run. Rights: runs.read and ragents.lsp-fsharp.read.

methods.name: ragents.lsp-roslyn.snapshot
methods.description: State and diagnostics of the language server ragents.lsp-roslyn in a run. Rights: runs.read and ragents.lsp-roslyn.read.

methods.name: ragents.lsp-roslyn.solutions
methods.description: The solutions in the workspace of a run and which of them ragents.lsp-roslyn has opened. Rights: runs.read and ragents.lsp-roslyn.read.

methods.name: ragents.lsp-roslyn.switch
methods.description: Loads a solution in ragents.lsp-roslyn and ends all other instances of the run; null ends all of them. Does not wait for the load. Rights: runs.read, runs.write, ragents.lsp-roslyn.read and ragents.lsp-roslyn.write.

anyOf.description: The solution relative to the workspace root

methods.name: ragents.lsp-typescript.snapshot
methods.description: State and diagnostics of the language server ragents.lsp-typescript in a run. Rights: runs.read and ragents.lsp-typescript.read.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.coordinator
methods.description: Read the run ID of your own global coordinator: one per signed-in user, exactly one without sign-in.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.createRun
methods.description: Create a run with a server-side ID and title. Exactly one start form: message, installed script (id or unique title), or packageDirectory (existing local run script package). input is only allowed with script/packageDirectory. options selects start options such as ragents.startOptions.select, each only with its own rights. sharing shares the run before its start like ragents.runs.share: everyone and individual users, each with read or write. The result waits for preparation, check, test and installation; accepted does not yet confirm a finished model result.

everyone.description: Access of every user of the profile; null shares with nobody as a whole

users.description: Individual users of the profile with their own access; never the caller, who owns the new run

sharing.description: Whom the new run is shared with from its creation on, as ragents.runs.share sets it; only with sign-in

everyone.description: Access of every user of the profile; null shares with nobody as a whole

users.description: Individual users of the profile with their own access; never the caller, who owns the new run

sharing.description: Whom the new run is shared with from its creation on, as ragents.runs.share sets it; only with sign-in

everyone.description: Access of every user of the profile; null shares with nobody as a whole

users.description: Individual users of the profile with their own access; never the caller, who owns the new run

sharing.description: Whom the new run is shared with from its creation on, as ragents.runs.share sets it; only with sign-in

packageDirectory.description: Absolute path of a RUN.md/setup.ts/tests.json package on the server. A local shell client inserts its actually existing package path; this is not an upload.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.listRuns
methods.description: List the runs the caller sees, with stable references; the global coordinators are not part of this list.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.readCatalog
methods.description: Read installed templates and start options with input schemas, default values and selectability. createRun starts messages, installed scripts or local packages via packageDirectory. Skills provide editable tasks for message; name the skill as the work instruction.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.readEvents
methods.description: Read the complete journal page by page in sequence order. As long as hasMore is true, use nextAfter as after of the next request. type filters an exact event type.

run.description: Run ID, unique title or stable reference such as Run 1.

payload.description: Unabridged domain value EventPayloads[EventType]; nested fields are deliberately an open JSON schema here.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.readOpenRpc
methods.description: Read OpenRPC 1.3 directly from the same contracts.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.readReference
methods.description: Read a readable reference of all registered methods and channels directly from their contracts.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.readRun
methods.description: Read the current unabridged RunView; nested domain values are documented as open JSON objects.

run.description: Run ID, unique title or stable reference such as Run 1.

items.description: Unabridged domain value Actor; nested fields are deliberately an open JSON schema here.
Unabridged domain value ActorInput; nested fields are deliberately an open JSON schema here.
Unabridged domain value Turn; nested fields are deliberately an open JSON schema here.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.reset
methods.description: Reset the conversation of your own global coordinator including its model context; the model selection, other users' coordinators and all runs are kept.

confirm.description: The conversation reset must be confirmed explicitly.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.sendMessage
methods.description: Enqueue a chat message for the primary LLM actor; TypeScript as primary is rejected with actor-chat-unsupported. The result only confirms the enqueueing, neither processing nor completion. A running turn is not replaced by it.

run.description: Run ID, unique title or stable reference such as Run 1.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.settings.read
methods.description: Read the global coordinator's model selection with the available model catalog.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.settings.save
methods.description: Set the global coordinator's model selection; it applies from the next answer on.

methods.name: ragents.overseer.stopRun
methods.description: Stop the run through its normal stop boundary and wait for the cleanup; the conversation is kept.

run.description: Run ID, unique title or stable reference such as Run 1.

methods.name: ragents.plugins.bootstrap
methods.description: Product, active plugins with web configuration, released templates and the server's RAgents version for the UI.

methods.name: ragents.processes.forward
methods.description: Forward one HTTP request to a port of the run's own processes on the machine the run works on, and return the response as it is; redirects are not followed, bodies are Base64 and at most 16 MiB. Without a request it only checks that a process of the run listens on the port. Rights: runs.read, runs.inspect and ragents.processes.read.

path.description: Path with query, as the service sees it

headers.description: Header names and values in order; a name may repeat
Header names and values in order; a name may repeat

methods.name: ragents.processes.snapshot
methods.description: The observed processes of a run with their open ports. Rights: runs.read and ragents.processes.read.

methods.name: ragents.processes.stop
methods.description: End a process of the run. Rights: runs.read, runs.write and runs.inspect.

methods.name: ragents.product.modelSettings.read
methods.description: The model defaults of the roles with the available model catalog. Right: settings.read.

methods.name: ragents.product.modelSettings.save
methods.description: Save the model defaults of the roles. Rights: settings.read and settings.write.

methods.name: ragents.runs.delete
methods.description: Delete a run with its data; a user who sees the run only through a share never deletes it (run-delete-denied). Rights: runs.read and runs.delete.

methods.name: ragents.runs.enqueueInput
methods.description: Put a message into the queue of an actor.

methods.name: ragents.runs.events
methods.description: Read all journal events of a run in sequence order.

methods.name: ragents.runs.export
methods.description: Fetch a stopped run as an archive: journal, payloads, model contexts and its plugin stores. Rights: runs.read and runs.inspect.

methods.name: ragents.runs.import
methods.description: Accept a run archive, replay its journal and open the run stopped. Rights: runs.read, runs.write and runs.create.

workspacePath.description: Replacement folder on this server for a run with binding path

methods.name: ragents.runs.interruptTurn
methods.description: Interrupt the running turn of an actor; the actor stays active and accepts the next input. Without a running turn nothing happens.

methods.name: ragents.runs.list
methods.description: All runs of the profile the caller sees, its own and those shared with it, with title, times, state (paused, running, waiting, idle, ended), pending actions, the caller's own seenRevision, whether the caller operates it (operable), its sharing for the caller (canShare and shared for whoever may change it, sharedAccess for whoever sees it only through a share), metadata and its list lines. Right: runs.read.

methods.name: ragents.runs.markViewed
methods.description: Record that the caller has viewed a run up to this revision; ragents.runs.list reports it back to the same user as seenRevision, on every device and host, and to nobody else. Only a higher revision counts. Right: runs.read.

revision.description: The viewed journal revision of the run

methods.name: ragents.runs.pause
methods.description: Pause the whole run: no turn of any actor starts any more, the running turns of all actors are interrupted, and later inputs wait in the journal. A human input or ragents.runs.resume continues it; a paused run stays paused without an error.

methods.name: ragents.runs.prepare
methods.description: Work out the task of a new run in a conversation with a separate coordinator instance. Rights: runs.read, runs.write, runs.create.

methods.name: ragents.runs.resolveAction
methods.description: Answer or dismiss a pending action.

methods.name: ragents.runs.restartActor
methods.description: Restart a stopped actor.

methods.name: ragents.runs.resume
methods.description: Continue a paused run without a message: the primary actor gets everything that waited in one turn, every other actor only once it is addressed directly. A run that is not paused stays as it is.

methods.name: ragents.runs.scripts
methods.description: The run scripts the caller may start, and for a running run whether each can start there now: available, otherwise reason (not embeddable, a fixed start option differs from the run's). Rights: runs.read, runs.write.

methods.name: ragents.runs.share
methods.description: Replace whom a run is shared with: every user of the profile (everyone) and individual users, each with read (sees the run, operates nothing) or write (operates it as far as the user's own rights go); a user gets the higher of both. Before the start the choice waits for the run's creation by the caller, afterwards it is written to the journal; an unchanged sharing writes nothing. A user unknown to the profile (share-user-unknown), the owner (share-owner) and a user named twice (share-user-duplicate) are refused. Result as ragents.runs.sharing. Rights as for ragents.runs.sharing.

anyOf.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

everyone.description: Access of every user of the profile; null for none

userId.description: Id of a user of the profile, never the run's owner

access.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

users.description: Individual users with their own access; a user gets the higher of everyone's and their own

anyOf.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

label.description: Display name; the id for a user the profile no longer has

access.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

users.description: The users of the profile the run can be shared with, without its owner

methods.name: ragents.runs.sharing
methods.description: Whom a run is shared with, each with its access, and the users of the profile it can be shared with. Before the start, the caller's own choice for the run it is about to create. Only with sign-in (sharing-unavailable), not for a global coordinator or a run without an owner (run-not-shareable). Rights: runs.read and runs.write, and the caller must own the run or have runs.read.all (run-sharing-denied).

anyOf.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

label.description: Display name; the id for a user the profile no longer has

access.description: read sees the run and operates nothing; write also operates it as far as the user's own rights go

users.description: The users of the profile the run can be shared with, without its owner

methods.name: ragents.runs.startScript
methods.description: Start a run script and wait until its actor has the start input; errors come back to the caller instead of the chat. A new run starts as with ragents.chat.start. In a running run only a script whose RUN.md sets embeddable: true starts, its fixed start options must match the run's, and the primary actor stays. Every start opens a new room named after the script with its own actors. Result: the script actor, its address (room.handle), and which start of its package this was. Rights: runs.read, runs.write and the template's release.

methods.name: ragents.runs.stopActor
methods.description: Stop an actor together with its delegated children.

methods.name: ragents.runs.stopAll
methods.description: Stop the whole run with all agents and flows.

methods.name: ragents.runs.view
methods.description: Read the run view, optionally the state after a journal sequence; null for a run that has not started yet.

methods.name: ragents.settings.read
methods.description: Models, plugins, tools, skills and runtime information of the profile. Right: settings.read; only locally or with access.

methods.name: ragents.settings.skill
methods.description: Read the files of a registered skill; null if it is not registered. Right: settings.read.

methods.name: ragents.settings.titles.read
methods.description: Read the model for automatic titles and the choices. Right: settings.read.

methods.name: ragents.settings.titles.save
methods.description: Set the model for automatic titles or turn their generation off. Right: settings.write.

methods.name: ragents.startOptions.list
methods.description: The start options of a run with value and presentation, only those whose own rights the caller has; the model choice, for example, requires runs.inspect. After the start, all except the changeable ones are locked. Rights: runs.read, runs.create.

methods.name: ragents.startOptions.select
methods.description: Choose a start option before the start, a changeable one such as the model choice also afterwards, taking effect from the next turn; if a right of the option itself is missing, the choice fails with access-denied. Rights: runs.read, runs.write, runs.create.

methods.name: ragents.workspace.browse.list
methods.description: List a directory in the workspace or in the file store of a run.

path.description: Path below the root; empty is the root itself

methods.name: ragents.workspace.browse.preview
methods.description: Preview a file as text; files that are too large or binary state the reason instead.

path.description: Path below the root; empty is the root itself

methods.name: ragents.workspace.clients.contributions
methods.description: The plugins' contributions to the executor that a workstation loads before sign-in and reports back with it. A workstation with a different executor version fails on its version; other fields do not matter.

executor.description: Version of the executor that the workstation brings

schema.description: The plugins' contributions to the executor, in the order of the server's plugin list

methods.name: ragents.workspace.clients.list
methods.description: The caller's signed-in workstations; other users' workstations do not appear even with runs.read.all.

runsDirectory.description: Absolute folder under which the workstation creates the new folders per run

ripgrep.description: Whether the workstation's bash finds rg

methods.name: ragents.workspace.clients.register
methods.description: Sign in a workstation or renew its folders; the connection of this request becomes its return path and needs an event stream. A workstation with a different executor version fails on its version before the rest of the shape matters.

runsDirectory.description: Absolute folder under which the workstation creates the new folders per run

ripgrep.description: Whether the workstation's bash finds rg

executor.description: Version of the executor that the workstation brings

contributions.description: The plugins' contributions to the executor, in the order of the server's plugin list

executor.description: Version of the executor that the workstation brings

anyOf.description: Sign-in with a different executor version in any shape; the server rejects it with workspace-executor-version

runsDirectory.description: Absolute folder under which the workstation creates the new folders per run

ripgrep.description: Whether the workstation's bash finds rg

methods.name: ragents.workspace.clients.unregister
methods.description: Sign out one of your own workstations; open tasks fail.

x-channels.name: ragents.chat
x-channels.description: The coordinator's chat history: first the stored history, then live. Rights as for reading the run; it ends as soon as the caller no longer sees the run because a share was taken back.

x-channels.name: ragents.processes
x-channels.description: The live state of a run's process monitoring. Rights: runs.read and ragents.processes.read.

x-channels.name: ragents.run
x-channels.description: Reports every new journal event of a run; first ready, then run. Rights as for reading the run; it ends as soon as the caller no longer sees the run because a share was taken back.

x-channels.name: ragents.runs
x-channels.description: Reports every change of the run list, also when a run is shared with the caller or no longer, a changed read marker only to its user. Right: runs.read.

x-channels.name: ragents.workspace.browse
x-channels.description: Reports every change below the observed root of a run.
